title: Noetherian component of polynomial formal fibre
statement: intermediate theorem used to prove formalFiber_isGeometricallyRegular

proof.text: The polynomial ring A[X] is Noetherian by Mathlib Polynomial.isNoetherianRing (Hilbert basis theorem). Its localization at q is Noetherian by the Mathlib localization instance. Apply AdicCompletion.isNoetherianRing to its maximal ideal, and register the resulting Noetherianity of the completion as a local instance. Apply Ideal.isNoetherianRing_fiber to r over this completion. The additional hypotheses concerning characteristic, completeness of A, and contractions of q and r are unnecessary for this component, but the statement is unchanged.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 07PU, Noetherianity component; Hilbert basis theorem and localization permanence (00FN), completion Noetherianity (0316), and fibre Noetherianity (00E6 and 00FN)

lean.statement: theorem formalFiber_isNoetherian (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A] (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) [CharP (Localization.AtPrime (⊥ : Ideal A)) p] (q : Ideal (Polynomial A)) [q.IsMaximal] (hq : q.comap (Polynomial.C : A →+* Polynomial A) = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) (r : Ideal (Polynomial A)) [r.IsPrime] (hrq : r ≤ q) (hr : r ≠ ⊥) (hrA : r.comap (Polynomial.C : A →+* Polynomial A) = ⊥) : let C := AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q)) (Localization.AtPrime q) IsNoetherianRing (r.Fiber C)
